title: EXTENSION HOUSING EXTENSION HOUSING INSPECTION
ocr_text:
AT-103
A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - EXTENSION HOUSING

EXTENSION HOUSING
EXTENSION HOUSING INSPECTION
AT06K-03
INSPECT EXTENSION HOUSING BUSHING
Using a cylinder gauge, measure the inside diameter of
the extension housing bushing.
Maximum inside diameter:
40.09 mm (1.5783 in.)
If the inside diameter is greater than the maximum, re-
place the extension housing.

AT7900
